scope: actual built workspace/model/forms plus explicit scoped negative-context fixtures; isolated Map storage only

tests.name: missing context API fails closed rather than falling back to a reason-only abandonment dialog
a live manual call may register a reason-only stop without pre-confirming missing content, while terminal missing content still needs confirmation
an unknown receipt permits only reason-only stopping and cannot be treated as a completed abandonment or missing-content waiver
ordinary text cannot bypass necessary original-person content and the confirmation starts unchecked
ADMIN confirmation submits exact run fingerprint and revision without fabricating archived or completed content
a real original person can return from the review to fill content instead of declaring it missing
an administrator cannot use the return-to-fill action as another predictive receiver
changed record revisions clear the old confirmation and retain the written reason until an explicit refresh
changed missing-content fingerprints clear a prior check even when the same segments remain
a changed run cannot borrow the prior run reason and confirmation
scope changes never submit an old tenant abandonment
unknown abandonment receipts keep one exact request and do not repeat the controlled action
ABANDONING records the old accepted queued attempt receipt while the UI refuses a new dispatch
the original person can fill necessary content while the run is still ABANDONING
legacy abandoned content has a separate explicit historical settlement entry without abandoning current DIRECT work
an original person supplement settles legacy abandoned debt dynamically without a new admin confirmation
settled history and foreign-tenant missing content never offer an enabled confirmation action
